title: The bootloader version that was stated is not this phone's
body: This run was started with the statement that the bootloader version read from the phone's other system copy is fake-0.9, the same as the copy in use. The copy in use has another version: the phone reports fake-1.0.
If the version was mistyped, start the installer again with the version that was read from the phone.

If fake-0.9 is what was read from the other copy, the two copies differ, and Omarchy Mobile can't be installed on this phone as it is. Don't write a bootloader by hand: a wrong one can leave the phone unable to start. Ask at https://github.com/derekross/omarchy-mobile/issues
footer: The installer only asked the phone what it is. It has written nothing to it.
Starting the installer again as things are will stop here again.
